I'm Vishal Sampath Kumar, a Melbourne-based postgraduate Business Analytics
student at Monash University. I completed my undergrad at Questrom School of Business, Boston University studying Business Administration with concentrations in Marketing and Business Analytics. I am passionate about using evidence and data to power decision making and enjoy using R, visualisation and reproducible workflows to make complex evidence easier to understand.

This website brings together my data stories and reflections on communicating research. My interests include statistical analysis, reproducible research and the choices that make a visual explanation
useful. Outside data science, I enjoy strength training, fragrances and travel.
